knowledgeCards.title: Helped feedback memory application
knowledgeCards.summary: Memory application feedback records helped, hurt, neutral, and stale outcomes without automatic promotion.
knowledgeCards.falsifier: A memory apply command mutates Memory Core directly.
knowledgeCards.doesNotProve: This does not prove arbitrary memory usefulness.

knowledgeCards.title: Hurt feedback activation exclusion
knowledgeCards.summary: Repeated hurt feedback should downgrade future activation instead of silently reusing stale context.
knowledgeCards.falsifier: A downgraded memory remains included after repeated hurt feedback.
knowledgeCards.doesNotProve: This does not prove broad forget quality.

knowledgeCards.title: Pattern usefulness evidence link
knowledgeCards.summary: Retained pattern usefulness needs outcome, reason, evidenceRef, and doesNotProve before helped feedback.
knowledgeCards.falsifier: A pattern usefulness capture omits evidenceRef but records helped feedback.
knowledgeCards.doesNotProve: This does not prove automatic pattern learning.

knowledgeCards.title: Source-to-decision retention gate
knowledgeCards.summary: Retained sources must name source, mechanism, KRN implication, decision, consumer, falsifier, and non-proof.
knowledgeCards.falsifier: A source decision is retained with no consumer.
knowledgeCards.doesNotProve: This does not prove source truth.

cases.query: source graph relation edge temporal readback

knowledgeCards.title: Graph relation readback boundary
knowledgeCards.summary: Expose SourceClaimEdge relation readback without treating graph relation support as source truth.
knowledgeCards.falsifier: Graph relationSupport is presented as proof of source truth.
knowledgeCards.doesNotProve: This does not prove graph ranking quality.

sourceClaims.claim: Source graph relation support is useful readback but not truth proof.
sourceClaims.mechanism: SourceClaimEdge rows expose relation summaries for inspection.
sourceClaims.krnImplication: Brain search should surface graph boundary guidance before graph tuning.
sourceClaims.falsifier: Relation support is treated as accepted source truth.
sourceClaims.doesNotProve: This does not prove source truth.

cases.query: accepted sourceclaim sourcedecisionedge support missing link

knowledgeCards.title: Accepted source decision link readback
knowledgeCards.summary: Accepted SourceClaims need visible SourceDecisionEdge support or an explicit missing-link caveat in readback.
knowledgeCards.falsifier: An accepted SourceClaim is called decision-supported with no decision edge.
knowledgeCards.doesNotProve: This does not prove accepted claims are true.

sourceClaims.claim: Accepted claims require decision-link readback before strong authority wording.
sourceClaims.mechanism: SourceDecisionEdge support separates accepted-only lifecycle from decision provenance.
sourceClaims.krnImplication: Brain search should keep accepted-only caveats visible.
sourceClaims.falsifier: Brain search hides missing decision-link evidence.
sourceClaims.doesNotProve: This does not prove source truth.

knowledgeCards.title: Second opinion governed review
knowledgeCards.summary: Headless Claude review must return validator-governed JSON with diff freshness and evidence refs.
knowledgeCards.falsifier: A slice trusts prose review output with no validated verdict JSON.
knowledgeCards.doesNotProve: This does not prove Claude judgment is correct.

knowledgeCards.falsifier: KRN static owner-file recall leaks into target projects.
